import math

def gcd(a, b):
    while b > 0:
        t = b
        b = a % b
        a = t
    return a

x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
t1 = gcd(x, y)
x //= t1
y //= t1

if n >= y:
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    a = x / y
    flag1 = a
    flag2 = 1
    ans = [0] * n
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        h = i * a
        t = math.floor(h)
        ans1 = abs(t / i - a)
        ans2 = abs((t + 1) / i - a)
        if flag1 > ans1 or flag1 > ans2:
            if ans1 > ans2:
                ans[i - 1] = t + 1
                flag2 = i
                flag1 = ans2
            else:
                ans[i - 1] = t
                flag2 = i
                flag1 = ans1
    print(f"{ans[flag2 - 1]}/{flag2}")
